name: Organizers' changed course, 2026-11-08
description: The organizers' changed course of 2026-11-08: the three maze walls are replaced by three new walls in the start area, measured from their new 3D model. Everything else is copied from the organizers' drawing (organizers_drawing.json) after checking it against the new model. The checkpoint lines 'end of first corridor' and 'Gate A' were placed from the old maze walls and are kept unchanged; check them.
